title: eXplore depths of shallows by twisting toothpicks into eyelids of tidal pools a sojourn for crustaceans who can claw into deep crevices of truth swimm
summary: eXplore depths of shallows by twisting toothpicks into eyelids of tidal pools a sojourn for crustaceans who can claw into deep crevices of truth swimming' below your cracked carapace #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
eXplore depths
  of shallows
by twisting toothpicks
into eyelids of
tidal pools
   a sojourn for
crustaceans
who can claw
into deep
crevices
  of truth swimming'
below your
     cracked
carapace
#smallpoems
